EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by aliphatic C–H stretches at 2883/2935/2980 cm⁻¹ and a strong CH deformation near 1458 cm⁻¹, consistent with saturated alcohol/ether systems (GFQ-003). The broad band at 1091 cm⁻¹ falls in the typical single-bond region for C–C/C–O stretching (GFQ-010), and the cluster of bands at 863/902/928 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of C–O–C/C–C–O skeletal modes seen in ethoxy/ether frameworks. Candidates with C=N, C=S, aromatic rings, or N–H/C–F (5, 3, 8, 7, 10) would show diagnostic bands (e.g., ~1650 cm⁻¹ for C=N, >3300 cm⁻¹ for N–H, ~1600 cm⁻¹ for aromatics) that are absent. Among the ether/alcohol candidates, 2-ethoxyethanol (1) best matches the known Raman pattern with bands near ~880–930, ~1090, ~1455, and ~2900–3000 cm⁻¹.
